name: beep-me
description: Send permission prompts, questions, and plan reviews to your phone, and bring Beep Me answers back to the agent.

url.title: Beep Me MCP URL
url.description: Your Beep Me MCP URL, for example https://beep-me.you.workers.dev/mcp. Agents > Connect shows it.

token.title: Agent token
token.description: A Beep Me agent token that starts with beep_. Create one under Agents > Connect > Plugin.

prompts.title: Send prompts to your phone
prompts.description: Send permission prompts, questions, and plan reviews to your phone when nobody answers in the terminal.

ask_after.title: Seconds before a prompt goes to your phone
ask_after.description: How long a prompt waits for an answer in the terminal before Beep Me sends it. 0 sends it at once.

priority.title: Priority of prompts
priority.description: The Beep Me priority of prompts. Your routes pick the channels for each priority.
